turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Morning, how are you feeling after the surgery?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Got some pain here, but not too bad lah.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: On a scale of 0 to 10, what’s your pain level?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Maybe 5? It’s there, but I can bear it.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Any nausea or feeling like you’ll vomit?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Stomach’s a bit upset, but no throwing up yet.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: Airway okay? Any sore throat or breathing trouble?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Throat sore a little, but breathing’s fine.

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: Nope, everything’s blank. Woke up here only.

turns.speaker: PROVIDER
turns.text: We’re watching your BP and sugar levels. Any worries?

turns.speaker: PATIENT
turns.text: BP’s been okay, sugar’s stable. Thanks for checking.
